title: Transport World A-Z
hook: One vehicle can fit more than one category.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D road-vehicle storybook, toy-like vehicles, safe roads, clean silhouettes; visual identity: Transport World A-Z

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing transport purpose and propulsion
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: purpose + mode + power caveat where known
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Transport World A-Z about purpose and energy transition: passenger, cargo, emergency, recreation, work, and electric/zero-tailpipe categories overlap without pretending one technology makes every trip sustainable.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares what is carried, where it travels, and how it is powered; Electric Car and Zero-emission Bus get precise tailpipe language.
